title: Machine learning diagnoses coeliac disease on duodenal biopsy slides
summary: A weakly supervised multiple-instance learning model was trained on 3,383 whole-slide images of duodenal biopsies from four hospitals and evaluated on an independent test set of 644 scans from a different region. The abstract reports accuracy, sensitivity and specificity above 95% and AUC above 99%. The evaluation is retrospective.
ai_technology: Multiple-instance learning classifier on whole-slide images

evidence.tested: Diagnostic performance on an independent retrospective test set of 644 scans from an unseen regional trust, with pathologist comparison.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective evaluation; prospective clinical effect not shown; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Weakly supervised classifier of coeliac disease on H&E duodenal biopsy slides.
